principle_violations.reason: The code violates the DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle in several places. The calculation of the amounts (this_amount) and the bonus points (volume_credits) contains repetitive logic for different theatre performance types. In addition, the currency formatting (division by 100) is performed several times in the code.
principle_violations.suggestion: The repetitive code parts should be outsourced to separate functions: A function for calculating the amounts (calculateAmount), a function for calculating the bonus points (calculateVolumeCredits), a central function for currency conversion and formatting and a separate class for the different performance types with their specific calculation logic

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
